correctness.rationale: For each triangular book B_r=K_(1,1,r), 1≤r≤7, an acyclic orientation is specified by a spine direction and three allowed spoke pairs per page; any directed four-cycle forces a forbidden oriented triangle. Thus |A_r|=2·3^r. The exact complete online-shattering recursion F_r(S,d)⇔∨_q(F_r(S∩Q_q,0,d−1)∧F_r(S∩Q_q,1,d−1)), with F(S,0) iff nonempty and |S|<2^d pruning, is equivalent by induction to existence of a depth-d complete adaptive edge-query tree. Independently implemented the entire exact bitmask recursion, obtaining Ldim r=1..7 as (2,4,5,7,8,10,11) and memoized state counts (11,72,224,1298,5396,28117,236276). Also directly inspected actual CERTIFICATE.json (187748 bytes, matching frozen Git blob) and independently validated its 3508 leaf witnesses, seven complete trees, acyclicity, uniqueness, query-path agreement and 2048 leaves for r=7. Consequently depth 12 fails at r=7 while entropy cardinality allows 12; r≤6 attain their cardinality upper bounds. This is a complete finite proof, not a timeout or extrapolation.
